book.name: MATEU
book.title: Eliywi no kuwaba lya Jesu Kilesite eli lina kun̄oliwa kwa MATEU

content: Omuliko wa Jesu
Cwale Emebo ya Nyambe sebeli itwaletela Jesu mu lihalaupa mukwetekiwa kwa Diyabulosi.
Munyima no ukuyumena eilya mu maywaa no kukwana makumi anee ni usiku no kukwana makumi anee, Jesu sebeli oyomba.
Cwale omweteki sebeli oiya kwa yonyene ni kumwambela nji, “Nji kame uli mwanaye Nyambe, wambele amawee aa nji atende esinkwa.”
Kono Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Nakuku n̄oliwa mu man̄olo nji, ‘Omunu katamba okuyoya kweyo no kulya fela, kono ku liywi lyonje eli litunda mu kanwa ka Nyambe.’ ”
Cwale Diyabulozi sebeli omutwala mu Jelusalema, omulenen̄i no kukena, nuka mutuleka ba mongola no Ndoo ya Nyambe,
ni kwamba kwa yonyene nji, “Nji kame uli mwanaye Nyambe, omatukele banji. Nakuku n̄oliwa mu man̄olo nji,

content.text: nji simba amakondo owe alese oukulemeka ku mawee.’”

content: Cwale Jesu sebeli omutambula nji, “Nakuku n̄oliwa mu man̄olo kame nji, ‘Ulese okweteka Mbumu Nyambe wowe.’ ”
Kame Diyabulozi sebeli omutwala ba lilundu no kuleba nukamumonisa emibuso no litunga yonje ni uwa walyo,
sebeli omwambela nji, “Eyi yonje mbani kubi, nji uni kubamena niku nilapela.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Otunde kwa mene Satani, naku kun̄oliwa mu man̄olo nji, ‘Olapele Mbumu Nyambe wowe mi obelekele yonyene feela!’ ”
Cwale Diyabulosi sebeli omusiya, mi amangeloi sebeli aiya muku mutusa.
Jesu Yo Tateka Omusebezi Waye mu Galileya
Cwale Jesu aba ana kuyupa nji Jowani nabekiwa mu mutolongo, sebeli oukela mu tolopo no Galileya.
Jesu sebeli otunda mu Nazaleta, nukayaka mu kapenauma omundi oli ku munanga no lisa lya Galileya mwikiliti ya Zebuloni ni Nafetali.
Nakutenda ngeeso okwiyateteta eso sina kwambiwa kwa munuhi wa Nyambe Isaya nji,

content.text: mu ndila no liwate, mu linjaliya lya Jodani,
Aanu awo ayoya mu uwi na mono eliseli linene. Naawo ayoya mu naha no mwinda no lufu, eliseli na limonahala kwa onyene.”

content: Kutunda eyo nako Jesu sebeli otateka okukutaza nji, “Mubake, kakuli omubuso na kuwilu sebeli uli beebi.”
Jesu Yo Isana Anduyi Anee

Abo Jesu aba ana kwendanga kunyonga no Liwate no Galileya, sebeli omona alume ayiili Simoni woyo wisaniwa nji Pitolosi ni minaye Andiliasi. Kame ana lemanga oku kondela otunyandi too mu Lisa kakuli neli andui.
Jesu sebeli wamba nji, “Komwiye muni kon̄e mi mbani mitende ayambi no aanu.”
Ababo sebeli asiya otunyandi too ni kumu kon̄a.
Cwale aba ana kusheteta ku lubala, sebeli omona Jakobo ni minaye Jowani aana a Zebedeya. Aikalile mu wato alemine okulukisa otunyandi too, mi sebeli waa isana.
Cwale ababo sebeli asiya owato ni sitoo okumu kon̄a.
Jesu Yo Iyeta, Okukutaza ni Kubalisa Aanu
Jesu sebeli ota mu Galileya monje, yo lemine okusimweta mu tindoo no milapelo ni kupaka eyi no ebangeli no kuwaba eyi no mubuso. Mane kame ana kubalisa aanu ku meeti oo onje.

Elibubo lyaye sebeli liyupahala mu ibaka yonje no Siliya, mi aanu sebeli alita kwa yonyene awo onje ana kutomanga ameeti no kusiyana, awo ana kwikalanga ni madimona, oweeti no kukwa ni awo no kombola etinyutu mi sebeli waa balisa.
Eli kwanamunu eli lina kutunda, mu Galileya, mu Dakapolisi, mu Jelusalema, mu Judeya ni mu naha na mulinjaliya lya Jodani sebeli amukon̄a.
